newsitem.title: UK: Ocean Group wins St.Eustatius tanker berthing deal.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Group wins St.Eustatius tanker berthing deal.

text.p: Ocean Group Plc unit Cory Towage said on Thursday it has signed a long term contract for the provision of tanker berthing and oil barge movements at St. Eustatius in the Netherlands Antilles.
Cory said it has agreed a five year contract for a two tug service with Statia Terminals. The main user of the terminal is Saudi Aramco.
Ocean Group director of corporate affairs Tony Lascelles said Cory Towage was tendering for a number of similar contracts.
"The future potential for the business is in growing international tug contracts. Towage is very profitable with a high return on capital," he said.
Ocean Group reported today that Cory Towage's operating profit fell 3.5 percent to 5.5 million stg in the first six months of 1997.
The group said growth was limited in the U.K. where major ports benefited from increased volumes, but this was offset by the impact of vessel disposals.
